title: 8.13. Kenaciviññeyyaduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nakenaci viññeyyaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nakenaci viññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nakenaci viññeyyaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nanakenaci viññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nakenaci viññeyyaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nakenaci viññeyyo ca nanakenaci viññeyyo ca dhammā uppajjanti hetupaccayā.
Nanakenaci viññeyyaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nanakenaci viññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi.
Nakenaci viññeyyañca nanakenaci viññeyyañca dhammaṁ paṭicca nakenaci viññeyyo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … tīṇi. (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
